versions.changelog:
No user-facing changes in this version.

- Version bumped to 1.0.1 with no detected file changes.

Initial release of Skirt Designer for AI-powered, customizable skirt design workflows.

- Generate customized skirt designs for print and manufacturing on demand using text prompts, structured parameters, reference images, text, and logos.
- Supports interactive 3D viewers and multi-view design generation for skirts.
- Integrates with the Craftsman Agent Clothing Designer app, supporting additional clothing types for broader use.
- Provides a REST API (`clothing_generator_design_draft`) for generating design drafts, with support for material, fit, decoration, logo placement, and manufacturing intent.
- Includes detailed setup instructions, environment variable configuration, and online resources for quick adoption.
